assignments.name: icp
assignments.value:
We build workflow automation and AI integrations for B2B companies.
Good fit: B2B companies with 10 to 1,000 employees (SaaS, agencies, professional services, logistics, healthcare groups, e-commerce brands) in any region; the contact is a decision maker or manager; they describe a concrete process to automate; they mention budget or a timeline.
Possible fit, a person decides: one-person businesses with budget and a concrete process, small businesses with 2 to 9 employees, companies whose stated budget is clearly too small for an automation project, companies with more than 1,000 and up to 5,000 employees, and enterprises above 5,000 employees that can buy without formal procurement (score them in the unsure middle range).
Poor fit: students, job seekers, people selling to us, spam, private persons, hobby or weekend projects, one-person businesses without budget, enterprises above 5,000 employees that require formal procurement, and requests unrelated to automation.
